name: Smart Buffer
description: Click up to 16 ticks early and the click is re-fired on the exact tick it becomes useful (landing, touching an orb). Normal clicks still go through instantly.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master toggle for the smart buffer.

window.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
window.description: How many physics ticks early you can click and still have it register on the frame-perfect tick. 'Off' disables buffering.
